title: Vehicle Program Equipment and KestrelCare Diagnostic Hours
content:
**Rule.** The vehicle program on the covered vehicle's purchase order adds diagnostic hours to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair order for the equipment its programs require: a vehicle sold as Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified adds the premium-program hours of 1.0 hour; a vehicle sold as Kestrel Certified or Kestrel Certified Plus adds the certified-program hours of 0.5 hour; any other program adds none.

The vehicle program is read from the Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order of the covered vehicle. The added hours are added to the diagnostic hours allowed for the vehicle system of the repair.

| Vehicle program | Hours added |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified, Kestrel Factory Certified | 1.0 |
| Kestrel Certified, Kestrel Certified Plus | 0.5 |
| any other program | none |

*Hypothetical:* an engine repair allowed 2.0 hours on a Kestrel Factory Certified vehicle is allowed 3.0 hours; on a Kestrel Certified Plus vehicle, 2.5 hours; on a Kestrel Value Line vehicle, 2.0 hours.
